scientific_integrity: Exact coordinate templates and standalone finite verification are included. Distinguishes proved universal claims from finite corroboration and does not claim independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Applies to inclusive radius 2 and graph shortest-path metrics on C6 square Cn for all integers n >= 7; no claim for other widths, periods or scales. Orbital locality argument is necessary for the infinite family; finite replay alone does not prove the universal statement.
title: A hexagonal-width Rips transition: \(S^1\) and \(2n\) two-spheres
